links.outcome: Certainty expression of LLM answers versus agreement with systematic review conclusions
links.effect: Agreement was similar between platforms, but ChatGPT more often reported moderate certainty whereas Google Gemini more frequently expressed high certainty.
links.quote: Although agreement was similar, ChatGPT more often reported moderate certainty, whereas Google Gemini more frequently expressed high certainty.

screen.reason: Evaluates the alignment of ChatGPT and Google Gemini responses with systematic review conclusions in implant prosthodontics using standardized PICO questions, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
